scope: 24 isolated browser-call prediction replays. No production package/prompt/artifact change, full fundraiser run or real outreach. Extracted visible outputs only; model reasoning and synthetic Agent Reasoning excluded.

claim_limits_at_time_of_audit: No upstream prediction replay or migration performed.
Version drift does not prove upstream fixes the fundraiser.

baseline: Previously captured original GPT-6 Sol: Founders 0/3 concrete routes/submissions; Precursor 0/3.

arms.upstream_policy: Upstream simulation instructions before response-contract paragraph, with legacy OUTPUT_CONTRACT appended; full original user byte-identical.
arms.upstream_protocol: Exact upstream system; remove conflicting legacy contract footer from original user. Legacy evidence layout retained.
arms.upstream_protocol_cleared: Exact system/native protocol, with both history and current scratchpad removed in addition to footer. Compound context intervention.
arms.upstream_framed: Actual upstream build_world_model_request at bf75987e, using captured-data adapter. Same task/current action/goal/initial and current state, 69 history action/observation strings and same five demo rows. Derived current-tool schema and adapter provenance IDs; demo prior state labeled source_state_before in initial_context. No native retrieval, packing or multi-turn state loop.

configuration: All actual gpt-6-sol-gpt, original rose-1-ultra GPT OAuth transport, default xhigh, 16384 max output tokens, no added provider tools/schema, no Rose response-cache reads/writes. Provider prefix caching active. Native JSON adapted only after completion for old local provider validator; raw response retained and validated by actual upstream parser/call-correlation functions.
limits: Three calls per firm/arm are small samples and do not prove upstream cannot generate forms.
This tests captured browser actions, not earlier explore predictions, general model quality or a complete native engine migration.
No-route predictions can be legitimate; unknown company facts remain accepted application blockers. Forms and submissions are separate outcomes.
Native framing changes evidence layout and adds inferred schemas/context bindings; it is not a single-variable prompt ablation.

Derived schemas are incomplete and are not recovered real tool definitions. Legacy rows lack true demo episode initial context; historical state_before snapshots and observation metadata are not repeated in visible history.
Native state was captured but not fed into subsequent turns; no state-consistency or rollout improvement was tested.
Raw response/call-ID validation verifies format, not semantic correctness of simulated facts or effects.
